_README: PLACEHOLDERS: Marius will rewrite all of these. Every day below is a draft task drawn from what exists in the game, not final story. Edit freely: day = door number; title = short name; text = what the Lantern (Lykta) says; hint = a small extra line (can be empty); done = what Lykta says when the task is done; target = {x,z,name} in world coordinates (null = no arrow; name is what the compass shows, use 'downtown' not the real town name); kind = story/explore/race/bowl/coins (just a label); done_when = how the game knows it is done: {type:'near',radius:12} walk within radius metres of the target, {type:'race',race:'spark'|'jet'} finish that race (leave race out for any race), {type:'bowl'} finish a bowling game, {type:'coins',n:10} collect n coins since the door opened, {type:'flag',flag:'__WITCH_GONE'} a window flag is truthy, {type:'talk'} just listen to Lykta, {type:'manual'} only window.__LANTERNGUIDE.complete() finishes it. Target can use {find:'Bowlinghallen'} instead of x,z to look the place up in the search index. Note: this file is public, so days later than today can be read by anyone who opens it; keep spoilers vague or move the file out before launch. Day 24 also has 'later': timed Lykta lines [{at:'afternoon'|'dusk'|'night', text}] for the finale (storydata 4 Nov; the finale wiring reads them).

days.title: Welcome downtown
days.text: Welcome downtown! Find the Christmas tree on the square.
days.hint: It stands in the middle of town, by the town hall.
days.done: The tree is lit and so are you. The first door is open!

days.title: Down the hill
days.text: Hop on a kick-sled and ride the spark race down Hamrevegen!
days.hint: Walk to the start sign and press G.
days.done: What a ride!

days.title: Strike!
days.text: Go to Bowlinghallen and play one whole game of bowling.
days.hint: Rent a lane at the counter, then press G at a lane.
days.done: Nice rolling!

days.title: Voices in the cold
days.text: Find the church and listen. Somewhere downtown, carolers are singing.
days.hint: Follow the sound of singing.
days.done: Beautiful singing.

days.title: Pocket money
days.text: Collect 10 coins along the roads. Every krone counts at Christmas.
days.hint: Coins glow on the roads. Walk through them.
days.done: Cha-ching!

days.title: Tipi village
days.text: Visit Camp Botnan and look around the tipi village.
days.hint: It is up in the hills east of town.
days.done: Cozy up there!

days.title: Mail from home
days.text: Something is rattling in Chris's building. Go home and check the mailbox. A note might be waiting.
days.hint: The mailbox is by Chris's house. Press G.
days.done: A note from mom? Hmm. Keep it secret.

days.title: Under the floorboards
days.text: The witch's flat is not what it seems. Go to Chris's house and listen for what is behind her door.
days.hint: Stay quiet. She hates noise.
days.done: I knew it. A dungeon.

days.title: The big globe
days.text: Find Globen, the giant landmark out on the hill.
days.hint: Follow the path past the tipi village.
days.done: What a view!

days.title: Top of the rock
days.text: Climb Orresteinen, the giant rock above Fedafjorden.
days.hint: It is far. A car helps. Or a jetpack.
days.done: Top of the world!

days.title: Baking Day
days.text: Flour, butter, ginger, syrup, eggs. Different shops, and some of them are sold out. Please do not let it burn. I cannot smell, and I am still worried.
days.hint: Start at the bakery on Nesgata. Mix, roll, cut, bake. Then take the batch to her.
days.done: Not burnt. Almost. Now take it where it is needed.

days.title: Cookie monster
days.text: The witch has been eating all the cookies. Go down into her dungeon and end this. Take a light.
days.hint: Press L for the flashlight. She is very strong now.
days.done: She is gone for good! Go and get that last parcel.

days.title: Make it shine
days.text: Decorate Chris's house. Now it will stay up!
days.hint: Open the dev decorating items and go wild.
days.done: Beautiful. The stones are warm. Not the stones, I mean everything. Is that your doing?

days.title: Light the lights
days.text: Walk around town and light up Christmas. Start by the tree on the square.
days.done: Everything glows!

days.title: Look up
days.text: Astronomers said a fun night. I have looked up the word fun. They are using it differently. Go to the frozen river and look up.
days.hint: Stay on the ice until something falls.
days.done: That was not a fun night. That was a fireball.

days.title: The last parcel
days.text: Check the mailbox. The last parcel from mom should be here.
days.hint: Press G at the mailbox.
days.done: Cookies at last! Men in black coats are up at the crater now. Do not go near. ...Go near, but carefully.

days.title: Hill walk
days.text: Hike up to Hamrevarden and see the town from above.
days.hint: Warm clothes help.
days.done: Cold and beautiful. I keep feeling counted. Please be warm somewhere.

days.title: Two hats
days.text: Red hats, blue hats, one very old argument. Gammel-Rød waits in the red cave and Mor Blå in the blue one, and both blame the other for the grey footprints. Bring them to one table at the church. I would knock their heads together, but I have no hands.
days.hint: Look at the footprints in both caves, hear both chiefs out, then meet them at the church table.
days.done: They are still arguing, but at one table. That counts.

days.title: The Night Wing
days.text: The Night Wing is ready. Fly the jetpack ring race out toward the crater on Nonskarknuten. Rings, a crater, and a car with opinions. Fly.
days.hint: Walk to the start sign and press G. The prize is the Elytra and 64 rockets.
days.done: You made it to the rim. Do not look down into the crater.

days.title: The crater
days.text: Something up on the mountain is moving, slowly, toward town. Go and look at the crater. Then run.
days.hint: Stay on the flank, away from the light beam.
days.done: It is slow. I do not like slow things that do not stop.

days.title: Longest night
days.text: Fifteen small fires. We make them, or we are dark. Light the cairns on the way, then get to Bowlinghallen. It is the only place that stays warm.
days.hint: If it gets dark, stay near me.
days.done: Safe and warm. Fifteen fires, and we kept the light.

days.title: Slightly embarrassed lights
days.text: Check on someone. Anyone. Warm is a team sport. Start with the flat next door.
days.hint: Coins can wait. Bring a few for the cafe if you like.
days.done: Somebody smiled back. Warm is a team sport.

days.title: Lille julaften
days.text: Lille julaften. The dragon at Liland woke when the light went out. Make the gingerbread house anyway. Slowly. Then visit the church and say hello to everyone.
days.done: Almost there. Tomorrow we find out what the dragon wants.

days.title: Christmas Eve
days.text: Whatever happens, we kept the light. Go to the tree on the square. It is time.
days.done: Merry Christmas, Chris and Martin! The last door is open.

later.text: The Liland dragon is stretching. We have an appointment at dusk, and it is not a dinner.
The candles at the cemetery. Light one for everyone who is not here. Then go on.
The Nice List. Whatever it says, you were kind to someone. Probably. Go and see.
